meta.name: Indu
meta.description:
Huge mansions have heinous secrets. As clandestine family ties, scandals and uncanny deaths spiral around the dark hallways of Indu's home, she leaves no stone unturned to untangle the mystery.

Rated U/A 16+ · Ended · First aired 22 Oct 2021 · IN · Language: Bengali
Studio: Missing screw · Network: hoichoi

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 8/8 | S3 7/7

On your server — Audio: Bengali

videos.title: Dodhi Mangal
videos.overview: It is Indu's wedding day but she does not make for a happy bride. The uncanny present from her future in-laws only makes it worse.

videos.title: Shajabo Jotoney
videos.overview: The Dasgupta family is all set for their eldest son's marriage. However, Khushi creates a mess that infuriates Annada, the family matriarch.

videos.title: Bashor Ghawr
videos.overview: Indu's painful past resurfaces at her wedding. Later that night, she encounters the silhouette of a woman that unnerves her further.

videos.title: Kaalratri
videos.overview: As Indu tries to get accustomed to the strange ways of her new family, weird happenings instigate her suspicion. Will she be able to discover their true colours?

videos.title: Phulshojya
videos.overview: Sougato loses his calm at the revelation of Indu’s buried past. Will the newlywed couple be able to consummate their marriage in peace?

videos.title: Bish pata
videos.overview: Indu becomes determined to know more about the mysterious Laboni. The Dasgupta family receives a piece of horrifying news.

videos.title: Biswash - Sandeho
videos.overview: The tragic news opens an array of deep dark secrets that leave Indu in a fix. Will she ever get to the core of the mystery, or will her new family's falsehoods prevail?

videos.title: Bhalo Meye, Bhalo Na
videos.overview: On probing, Indu realises that one man has been behind all the mishappenings. Will their confrontation dig up skeletons from the past, ruining the dream of a hopeful tomorrow?

videos.title: Parbe Sherlock Holmes?
videos.overview: Laboni's mysterious death keeps haunting Indu. Amidst the ongoing investigation, everyone tries to hide the devil's trumpet.

videos.title: Rohoshyer Gawrbhey Rohoshyo
videos.overview: Sujato decides to perform the last rites for Laboni, going against everyone. Sougata's strange behavior further fuels Indu's suspicion.

videos.title: Sandeho Rog
videos.overview: A mysterious woman tries to lure Indu's suspicious mind. Sougata's worsening condition leads Indu to a devastating state.

videos.title: Post-mortem
videos.overview: People of the household start hiding their secrets after another sudden demise. Indu becomes desperate to track down that mysterious woman.

videos.title: Dhnowa
videos.overview: The police find traces of the devil's trumpet in Sougata's postmortem report. Indu becomes one of the prime suspects in the puzzling circumstance.

videos.title: Devil Maane Bhoy
videos.overview: While everyone tries to hinder Indu's plans to catch the 'devil', she receives a startling piece of information about that elusive woman.

videos.title: O Bhoy Payena
videos.overview: Indu's growing curiosity about Koushani's in-laws makes Sujato uncomfortable. To everyone's horror, Indu comes across the gruesome truth about a veiled scandal.

videos.title: Shesh Tobu Shesh Noy
videos.overview: Everything starts falling apart as Indu gets to the root of the deepest secret of the Dasgupta family. Destiny makes Indu face another fatal fall that brings in a new tide of mystery.

videos.title: Dhadha
videos.overview: Sujato is held for Charu’s murder, but a mysterious note warns Indu that the battle is not yet over.

videos.title: Kanak Bhringraj
videos.overview: Annada is attacked, but dhutro poison in her body hints at a deeper, deadly game.

videos.title: Sondeho
videos.overview: Charu’s death reveals dhutro poison, few Kanak Bhringraj bottles go missing, and threat notes grip the house in fear.

videos.title: Onneshon
videos.overview: Indu’s probe into Laboni’s hostel unearths dark secrets, but the night turns brutal when Mihir is suddenly attacked.

videos.title: Chhol Kopot
videos.overview: A burning husk with dhutro seeds are thrown inside Indu's room. Mihir gives answers, Indu meets someone for vital clues.

videos.title: Jobonika Poton
videos.overview: Indu gives evidence against Sujato. Police move to arrest him, but an unexpected revelation changes everything.

videos.title: Swikarokti
videos.overview: Indu's investigation reaches its deadly climax, family secrets unravel completely, unmasking the true threat.
